CheckTitle: TMS predefined tags should be configured
Description: Ensure that predefined tags are configured in Tag Management Service to enable resource classification and governance.
Risk: Without predefined tags, resources cannot be consistently classified or audited by owner, project, or environment, leading to governance gaps and difficulty in cost allocation.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console
2. Navigate to Tag Management Service
3. Click Create Tag
4. Define mandatory tags such as environment, owner, and project

Recommendation.Text: Define predefined tags (e.g. environment, owner, project) in Tag Management Service to enable resource governance.
